description: Look up open roles across the space industry (launch providers, satellite and spacecraft makers, and the suppliers behind them), gathered from the job boards of 150 employers. Each result gives the title, employer, kind of work, posted pay, the countries it accepts applicants from and an apply link on SpaceJobs.Now. Any filter can be left out.

country.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code such as 'US', 'IN' or 'BR'; keeps only roles that accept applicants from there.

kind.description: Restrict results to one kind of work, given as an enum slug such as 'propulsion', 'mechanical-structures', 'avionics-electrical'.

limit.description: Maximum number of results, anywhere from 1 to 25.

min_hourly_usd.description: The same floor as an hourly rate, counted at 2,080 hours a year. Use min_pay_usd unless the person asked in hourly terms.

min_pay_usd.description: Minimum pay as a year's pay in US dollars, e.g. 120000: a role passes when the top of its posted range reaches it. An hourly posting counts at 2,080 hours (40 a week for 52 weeks).

platform.description: Employer slug, e.g. 'spacex', 'blue-origin', 'rocket-lab'. get_space_jobs_market lists them.

query.description: Words to look for in role titles, such as 'propulsion', 'avionics', 'technician' or 'mission operations'.

name: search_space_jobs
title: Search space industry jobs
